snippet.title: It Has My Face | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Kill your clone before it kills YOU!

In this roguelite sandbox horror game, experience true paranoia as you hide, hunt, and try to eliminate your double. Fight to survive as you unravel this terrifying tale of clones and biological horrors!
